acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: A derived ADR makes guest/public and Staff/AI trust zones, authenticated rate-limited cross-account HTTPS integration, separate credentials/quotas/deployments/failure boundaries, and booking-path isolation explicit without selecting or provisioning infrastructure.

confirmed: The roadmap names inward-facing provider-neutral ports for persistence, event ingestion, analytics sources, scheduling/queues, workflow execution, object storage, notifications, intelligence, deployment, and authentication; future cores may not import Cloudflare, Supabase, GitHub, OpenAI, LINE, or local-server SDKs.

confirmed: Permanent roadmap and backlog rules keep raw clicks, page views, scrolls, and marketing telemetry in source systems; only bounded aggregates and allowlisted operational/audit records may enter AI OS, and no permanent row, message, workflow, or AI invocation is created per guest interaction.

confirmed: Future packets define configurable retention for temporary ingestion, debug logs, prompts/outputs, workflow detail, aggregates, incidents, and audit evidence, including scheduled deletion, aggregation, archival, and later local transfer without historical-evidence rewriting.

confirmed: Future packets define deterministic resource budgets for worker, queue, workflow, persistence, runner, AI, and notification usage; warning thresholds at 50%, 75%, and 90%; pre-hard-limit fail-closed behavior; and workload safeguards including batching, deduplication, idempotency, backpressure, rate/concurrency/retry limits, dead-lettering, priorities, and scheduled summaries.

confirmed: Bounded future packets and an acyclic dependency graph exist for trust-zone/port contracts, minimisation/retention, quota governance, provider-neutral persistence composition, local/self-hosted migration readiness, and quota/saturation verification.

confirmed: Current Phase 1-2 facts are corrected without retroactively changing terminal acceptance criteria or historical evidence; no completed Phase 2 product remediation is claimed unless a concrete defect is found.

confirmed: QA gates explicitly reject provider SDK imports in core/domain logic, unauthenticated Staff/AI exposure, shared guest/internal failure or quota boundaries, per-click permanence or AI invocation, missing retention/budget authority, unbounded workloads, and booking-impacting saturation.
